name: search-and-ranking
title: Guide: Search and Ranking
description: Agent-facing guide for buyer listing search, filter usage, pagination, sorting, and geo-aware queries.
text:
# Search and Ranking

TL;DR:
- Use filter for public buyer-facing constraints.
- Use listingCollection for browse/search and listingFetch for one concrete result.
- range is expressed in kilometers and works together with meta.latLon.

Tool choice:
- buyer.listingCollection: browse, search, paginate, and sort published listings.
- buyer.listingFetch: retrieve one concrete published listing that matches a focused query.

Query rules:
- Prefer filter for all public MCP filtering.
- Treat where as an internal app compatibility concept, not as the public MCP path.
- Use sort when ordering matters.
- Use cursor for pagination.

Geo behavior:
- range is measured in kilometers.
- range only makes sense together with meta.latLon.
- When geo context is available, distance is returned in kilometers and geo sorting becomes meaningful.

Canonical examples:
- Listings with personal pickup: filter.deliveryIn = ["personal"]
- Listings delivered by post: filter.deliveryIn = ["post"]
- My listings in buyer context: filter.my = true
- Listings within 30 km: filter.range = 30 plus meta.latLon
- One concrete listing by id: buyer.listingFetch with filter.id
